name: VoxelGrid::CreateFromPointCloudWithinBounds
definition: A method to voxelize a point cloud within specified bounds by mapping input points to voxel indices based on a fixed voxel size and minimum bound, ignoring the maximum bound for coordinate calculation.
summary: VoxelGrid::CreateFromPointCloudWithinBounds voxalizes point clouds into sparse grids using direct hash-map accumulation, offering significantly faster performance than mesh-based conversion methods.
